findings.evidenceJa: ぶるぶると震えてゴーゴー。
findings.governingReading: Shiver and tremble, then go-go or roar onward

findings.highlight: They echo loudly in my head
findings.evidenceJa: きんきんうるさく響く
findings.governingReading: The voices ring piercingly and noisily
findings.explanation: The English preserves loud echo but loses the shrill metallic quality and adds “in my head.”
